purpose: AI/developer visual investigation and artistic review of the real JWEB city, generator specimens, and exact geometry fixtures using the same render/physics/semantic authorities as the game
integration_state: live lazy host seam installed in current main.js; normal boot does not statically import the harness

modes.real_city: normal main.js runtime with streamed and authored payloads, live materials/lighting/post-processing, camera travel, exact screen capture, targeted isolation, diagnostics, and artistic passes
modes.generator_specimen: one deterministic KowloonFabricEngine payload in an empty scene; main.js and the streamed world are not booted
modes.direct_fixture: geometry-harness spec instantiated directly in an empty scene; no main.js, streamer, world, or Kowloon chunk generation

output: ZIP containing normal and diagnostic PNGs plus manifests with purpose/lenses, semantic IDs, owner/chunk, authority/selection/frame bounds, cameras, exact render fragments, source instance indices, collision/semantic proxy counts, and collision-free segmentation maps
tests: browser: tools/visual-harness/browser-selftest.html must report PASS on a WebGL-capable desktop browser

portability.core_host_contract: THREE + scene + camera + renderer + optional composer/chunk navigation callbacks + getPayloadEntries/getStatus
portability.policy: keep the live seam tiny and lazy; when JWEB ownership moves, adapt that seam fresh instead of teaching the harness old source layouts
